messaging.turnOnExplain: The gateway connects it after a restart.

messaging.testTip: Ask Hermes whether this channel is connected

mcp.applyNote: Hermes connects MCP servers when a conversation starts: new chats see the change, a running one after /new or /reset.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.tokenHint: Stored in the profile .env, never in config.yaml.
mcp.title: MCP
mcp.description: Model Context Protocol servers give Hermes extra tools (GitHub, files, databases…).
mcp.removeDesc: Deletes it from mcp_servers in config.yaml. {{applyNote}}
mcp.noServersBody: Add one to give Hermes new tools.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: What Hermes spent across every channel: Telegram, cron, this app and the API. Numbers come from the Hermes session store (token counts each provider reported). Cost is the provider's billed amount when it reports one, otherwise Hermes' estimate from its model price table, so treat it as an approximation; free providers show $0.
usage.noSkillActivity: No skill activity in this period.

system.title: System
system.description: Health of Hermes and the machine it runs on.
system.restartDesc: Active runs on every channel (Telegram included) are interrupted. The WebUI stays up and reconnects.
system.didNotComeBack: Hermes did not come back within 90s. Check the logs.
system.doctorDesc2: checks for config, keys and dependencies.
system.updatesDisabled: Applying updates from the WebUI is disabled: this Hermes install carries local patches and updates through its own flow.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: What the agent and gateway are doing right now.

about.title: About
about.description: Hermes WebUI: a browser home for your Hermes Agent.
about.sourceDesc: The same repository on three hosts. Issues and ideas are welcome on any of them.
about.yutheme: YuTheme, the look of this app, created by Yuri Cunha.
about.yucode: YuCode, the terminal-style chat and code skin (Settings > Appearance), created by Yuri Cunha.
about.license2: . Run it, study it, change it, share it.

cli.title: Hermes CLI
cli.description: Restricted bridge to the Hermes binary. No shell, no arbitrary commands: argv is executed directly, output is capped and secrets are redacted before they reach the browser.

rawConfig.title: Raw Config
rawConfig.descMid: , saved by Hermes itself; invalid YAML is refused before it is applied. Every key is explained in the

fieldDetail.unknownSetting: Unknown setting. It may exist in a newer Hermes version — check Raw Config.
fieldDetail.saveHint: Saving deep-merges into the real Hermes config.yaml. Some changes apply on the next turn; others need a gateway restart (System → Restart Hermes).

env.restartNote: New conversations read it; the gateway (Telegram, cron) picks it up after a restart in Settings > System.
env.title: Environment
env.description: API keys and settings in Hermes' .env. Values are always masked; to change one, type the new value.
env.newValuePlaceholder: New value (the current one is never shown)
env.removeDesc: The variable is deleted from the Hermes .env. Anything that needs it stops working until it is set again.

profile.soulSaved: SOUL saved. New conversations use it; a running one after /new or /reset.
profile.soulDesc: The personality and standing rules every conversation starts from.
profile.noSoul: No SOUL.md yet. Switch to Edit to write one.
profile.saveSoulDesc: This rewrites SOUL.md in the profile folder. Hermes reads it when a conversation starts: new chats get it right away, and a conversation already running (Telegram included) only after /new or /reset.
profile.name: Name
profile.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, - and _. Used as `hermes -p <name>`.
profile.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers, - and _ only.
profile.freshDesc: Default config with the bundled skills.
profile.settingsDesc: Config, skills and SOUL are copied; memory and conversations start empty.
profile.allDesc: Memory, skills and history are copied too. Bot tokens are never copied, so two profiles do not fight over one bot.
profile.created: Profile {{name}} created. Give it a SOUL below; its bots and gateway are set up separately.
profile.newProfileSubtitle: A separate Hermes: its own SOUL, memory, skills and bots
profile.deleteDesc: This deletes the whole profile folder: its SOUL, memory, skills, conversations and bot settings. Its gateway is stopped first. Type {{name}} to confirm.
profile.nameMismatch: The name did not match; nothing was deleted.
profile.renameDefaultDesc: The default profile keeps its folder; this only changes the name shown.
profile.renameDesc: Renames the profile folder. Its gateway is stopped during the rename, and anything that calls it by the old name (scripts, `hermes -p`) needs the new one.
profile.describeDesc: A short role line (what this profile is for). Hermes uses it to route work between profiles.
profile.title: Profile & SOUL
profile.description: Who Hermes is: its profiles, models and personality.
profile.profilesDesc: Each profile has its own SOUL, memory, skills and bots. Pick one to read or edit its SOUL.

toolsetSheet.nextChat: New conversations use it (/new or /reset for a running one).
toolsetSheet.nothingToSet: Nothing to set up here: this toolset only has the on/off switch.
toolsetSheet.providerDesc: Pick who does the work. Keys are saved to Hermes' .env and never shown again.
toolsetSheet.nousAuth1: Billed to a Nous Portal subscription. Log in once with
toolsetSheet.nousAuth2: on the server, then pick it here.
toolsetSheet.postSetup: Hermes installs what it needs the first time you turn this on.
toolsetSheet.missingKey: Add the key above to use this provider.

memoryFiles.memoryHint: Facts, rules and project notes Hermes keeps.
memoryFiles.updated: {{file}} updated. New conversations see it (/new or /reset for a running one).
memoryFiles.empty: Empty. Hermes adds entries as it learns; you can add one too.
memoryFiles.deleteDesc: Hermes forgets it from {{file}}. Running conversations keep their copy until /new or /reset.

memoryProvider.applies: New conversations use it; a running one after /new or /reset.
memoryProvider.installHadErrors: {{name}} setup had errors; see the log.
memoryProvider.installDesc: Hermes runs the install steps listed above on the server. It can take a few minutes.
memoryProvider.switchBackTitle: Switch back to the built-in memory?
memoryProvider.switchBackDesc: Hermes stops using {{name}}. What it stored there stays there; the built-in MEMORY.md and USER.md take over.

pending.gateOn: Hermes stages every {{noun}} write here until you approve it.
pending.approveAllDesc: Each one is applied exactly as shown.
pending.rejectAllDesc: They are discarded; Hermes will not save them.
